title: Valuables Floater Nonrenewal Grounds
content:
Larkspur Valuables Floater underwriting guide, nonrenewal. Two grounds lead Larkspur to nonrenew a floater at the end of its term. A nonrenewed floater expires at its expiration date, and its record shows the ground: reappraisal missing or theft frequency.

## Ground 1: reappraisal missing

Items above the tier's written-appraisal threshold whose appraisal is older than the tier's re-appraisal cycle on the renewal offer date must be re-appraised before renewal; if not, the floater is nonrenewed with the reason reappraisal missing, on the tier's minimum advance notice of nonrenewal.

- The items concerned are only those scheduled above the written-appraisal threshold; an item at or below the threshold is not caught by this ground.
- The age of the appraisal is taken on the renewal offer date.

## Ground 2: theft frequency

The floater is also nonrenewed with the reason theft frequency when its count of theft claims reaches the tier's nonrenewal threshold.

The count is defined precisely: the number of distinct claim numbers on the floater whose cause is theft or mysterious disappearance and which have at least one claim payment that has not been voided, within the tier's claims lookback window of years ending on the renewal offer date.

| Claim on the floater, within the lookback window | Counts? |
|---|---|
| Theft claim with one payment issued and not voided | yes, once |
| Mysterious disappearance claim with two payments, neither voided | yes, once (one claim number) |
| Theft claim whose only payment was voided | no |
| Theft claim denied, with no payment | no |
| Breakage, fire or water claim, paid | no |

"Reaches" means the count equals or exceeds the threshold.

## Hypothetical cases

- A hypothetical Valuables Floater Classic, whose threshold is 2, with one paid theft claim and one paid mysterious disappearance claim inside the lookback window: the count is 2, the threshold is reached, and the floater is nonrenewed with the reason theft frequency.
- The same claims on a hypothetical Valuables Floater Prestige, whose threshold is 3: the count is 2 and the threshold is not reached on this ground.
- A hypothetical Valuables Floater Preferred with a ring scheduled at 9000 USD, above its 5000 USD threshold, last appraised six years before the renewal offer date against a five-year cycle: the ring must be re-appraised before renewal; without the re-appraisal the floater is nonrenewed with the reason reappraisal missing.
